Online purchase originated from device profile 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 8.1 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1680x1050' (desktop, proxy: nan). Device recognized in historical baseline.

case.summary: Investigation of alert HHG-015 confirmed unauthorized card not present new device on card C03042-K1. Flagged transaction 3464869 ($599.94) deviated from baseline, and cardholder confirmed lack of authorization. Under Policy Rule R2, the card was recommended for block (route: L1) with total financial exposure of $599.94.
